// Generator of go-oracle.json: the archives Go's archive/tar.Writer writes for
// the headers js-prueffactory sets (root-owned, no times, no user names).
// Names and contents are hex, so names that are not valid UTF-8 survive JSON.
// Kept as text; regenerate with:
// mkdir /tmp/x && cp go-oracle.go.txt /tmp/x/main.go && go run /tmp/x/main.go > go-oracle.json
package main

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
)

type entry struct {
	Type     string `json:"type"`
	Name     string `json:"name"`
	Linkname string `json:"linkname"`
	Mode     int64  `json:"mode"`
	Size     int64  `json:"size"`
	Content  string `json:"content"`
}

type archive struct {
	Title   string  `json:"title"`
	Entries []entry `json:"entries"`
	// HeaderOnly: the bytes after the last WriteHeader, without content or close.
	HeaderOnly bool   `json:"headerOnly"`
	Tar        string `json:"tar"`
	Error      string `json:"error"`
}

func dir(name string) entry { return entry{Type: "directory", Name: name, Mode: 0o755} }

func file(name, content string) entry {
	return entry{Type: "file", Name: name, Mode: 0o644, Size: int64(len(content)), Content: content}
}

func link(name, target string) entry {
	return entry{Type: "symlink", Name: name, Linkname: target, Mode: 0o777}
}

func main() {
	long := strings.Repeat("d", 60) + "/" + strings.Repeat("e", 60) + "/" + strings.Repeat("f", 80) + ".txt"
	exe := file("d/run.sh", "abc")
	exe.Mode = 0o755
	cases := []archive{
		{Title: "folder, executable, link", Entries: []entry{dir("d/"), exe, link("d/link", "run.sh"), file("d/empty", "")}},
		{Title: "content spans blocks", Entries: []entry{file("big", strings.Repeat("0123456789", 103)), file("next", "x")}},
		{Title: "name of exactly 100 bytes", Entries: []entry{file(strings.Repeat("n", 100), "n")}},
		{Title: "long name split into prefix and name", Entries: []entry{file(long, "long")}},
		{Title: "long name that cannot be split", Entries: []entry{file("d/"+strings.Repeat("f", 120)+".txt", "pax")}},
		{Title: "long folder name", Entries: []entry{dir(strings.Repeat("x", 120) + "/")}},
		{Title: "UTF-8 names", Entries: []entry{dir("été/"), file("été/été.txt", "summer")}},
		{Title: "names that are not valid UTF-8", Entries: []entry{file("a\xfe.js", "fe"), file("a\xff.js", "ff"), link("l\xff", "a\xff.js")}},
		{Title: "long link targets", Entries: []entry{link("long-link", long), link("accent", "été.txt")}},
		{Title: "a dropped byte leaves a slash at the end of the name field", Entries: []entry{file("\xff"+strings.Repeat("x", 99)+"/"+strings.Repeat("y", 10), "slash")}},
		{Title: "PAX record length grows a digit", Entries: []entry{file("\xff"+strings.Repeat("a", 91), "91"), file("\xff"+strings.Repeat("a", 90), "90")}},
		{Title: "size beyond the octal field", HeaderOnly: true, Entries: []entry{{Type: "file", Name: "huge", Mode: 0o644, Size: 1 << 33}}},
		{Title: "NUL in a name", Entries: []entry{file("a\x00b", "")}},
		{Title: "file name with a slash at the end", Entries: []entry{file("a/", "")}},
	}
	types := map[string]byte{"file": tar.TypeReg, "directory": tar.TypeDir, "symlink": tar.TypeSymlink}
	for i := range cases {
		c := &cases[i]
		var buf bytes.Buffer
		tw := tar.NewWriter(&buf)
		var err error
		for _, e := range c.Entries {
			err = tw.WriteHeader(&tar.Header{Typeflag: types[e.Type], Name: e.Name, Linkname: e.Linkname, Mode: e.Mode, Size: e.Size})
			if err != nil || c.HeaderOnly {
				break
			}
			if _, err = tw.Write([]byte(e.Content)); err != nil {
				break
			}
		}
		if err == nil && !c.HeaderOnly {
			err = tw.Close()
		}
		if err != nil {
			c.Error = err.Error()
		} else {
			c.Tar = hex.EncodeToString(buf.Bytes())
		}
		for j := range c.Entries {
			e := &c.Entries[j]
			e.Name = hex.EncodeToString([]byte(e.Name))
			e.Linkname = hex.EncodeToString([]byte(e.Linkname))
			e.Content = hex.EncodeToString([]byte(e.Content))
		}
	}
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	enc.SetIndent("", "  ")
	if err := enc.Encode(map[string]any{
		"recordedFrom": "Go " + strings.TrimPrefix(runtime.Version(), "go") + " archive/tar, the toolchain of the freeze commit 238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8",
		"archives":     cases,
	}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
